findings.one_line: The main Gaussian-limit claim names the uniform fixed-source benchmark, but its theorem-level positioning does not compare the claimed variable-coefficient, generated-target, four-sample result with the separately listed 2026 influence-function and potential-FCLT literatures or state precisely why neither supplies this conclusion.

The matched Hellinger-local risk theorem is a separate headline contribution, yet the note gives no immediately adjacent comparison to the cited global map-risk and CiC-inference results explaining the distinction between its pointwise nested target, local experiment, and claimed rate contribution.
